title: Wall Mount Shower Squeegee 15-Inch Solid Brass With Hook, Traditional Style | Satin Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Keep shower doors, tile, and mirrors clearer with quick, easy strokes using this wall mount shower squeegee crafted from solid brass in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass.

Highlights:
- Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Blade can be easily replaced
- Designer finish is built for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Traditional style to suit traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures

Specs:
- Overall size: 10-Inch L x 10-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Projection: 3-Inch
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 3.2 lb
- Included items: Squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
